prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1022; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss for sideswipe collision during lane change. Insured reports other vehicle merged into their lane on the highway and contact occurred at the rear quarter panel. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles requested from insured.

Entry 2: Claimant's representing attorney's office contacted the desk and confirmed representation. All further communication to be routed through counsel. Claimant reports neck strain following the collision and has started treatment with a chiropractor. Medical authorization request sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos submitted by insured. Damage consistent with side contact at low speed. Rear quarter panel and door trim affected on the insured vehicle. Independent appraisal assigned to confirm repair estimate and check for hidden structural damage.

Entry 4: Received medical records from treating provider. Diagnosis listed as cervical strain with muscle spasm. Records indicate claimant missed several days of work and is continuing physical therapy. Reviewing records against the accident description and prior treatment history in the file.

Entry 5: Spoke with defense-side counsel regarding liability. Recorded statement from the other driver indicates a lane change without signaling. Liability position under review, with preliminary assessment favoring the insured's claim as not at fault. File set for supervisor review pending receipt of all medical bills and the appraisal report.
